headline: The Most Disturbing 2000s Reality Show Doesn’t Seem So Crazy Anymore
context: Erin Lee Carr’s new documentary revisits the 2004 makeover show “The Swan,” which gave 32 women extensive plastic surgery and anticipated where beauty culture was headed.
